create_submarine.configuration.ballastLi:
Submarine mass each ballast tank can drive up or down (roughly 1 per block).
Total lift scales with the number of tanks: a heavy submarine needs more of them.
create_submarine.configuration.ballastVe: Maximum vertical speed (blocks per tick) ballast tanks drive the submarine at when diving or ascending. Higher = faster. The old fixed value was 2.0.
create_submarine.configuration.enableBoa: Hide the ocean surface seen inside floating boats (sub-levels without an oxygen system).
create_submarine.configuration.floaterLi:
Mass each floater can push toward the surface (roughly 1 per block).
Total lift scales with the number of floaters.
create_submarine.configuration.oxygenMax: Maximum size, in blocks, of a creation that oxygen diffusers can scan and fill with breathable air. Raise this if air pockets stop working on very large ships. WARNING: large values use more memory and take longer to scan.
create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_1: The Barometer indicates the pressure applied on the submarine.
create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_2: It compares it to the maximum pressure the hull can sustain based on its weakest block.
create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_3: You can also name the fish inside with a Name Tag to have a companion in the abyss!
create_submarine.ponder.barometer_displa: You can attach a Display Link to the Barometer.
This allows you to broadcast the submarine's depth and hull integrity to any Display Board!
